indicator_name: Official KZT exchange rates against partner currencies, monthly average
description: Официальные курсы тенге к валютам торговых партнёров, среднее за месяц
unit: KZT per one unit of the currency
methodology: Weekday mean of the NBK official rate, 18 currencies (USD, EUR, CNY, RUB, TRY, KRW, UZS, KGS, BYN, JPY, GBP, INR, CHF, CZK, PLN, AED, TJS, AZN) from 2010-01. UZS and BYN from 2014-02 (printed below 1 KZT per unit before, too coarse to use); BYN restated in post-2016 roubles (÷10 000 redenomination applied to earlier quotes). Item USD, EUR, CNY and RUB are the monthly means of the scalar daily EXCHANGE_RATE* series.
